fusions.name: Blind-Side Cut
fusions.desc: Slips a hidden blade into the target, dealing 40 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. The hit always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Flick Blade
fusions.desc: Flicks a hidden blade at the first enemy in its path, dealing 4 damage. It has 50% more critical chance against an enemy that has not been wounded yet.

fusions.name: Sharpened Resolve
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeve Edge
fusions.desc: When you kill something, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
